title: The weak maximizing property for $(L_p([0,1]),L_q([0,1]))$
summary: We solve [4, Question 4.2] left open by Dantas, Jung and Martínez-Cervantes by providing a complete characterization for the pairs $(L_p([0,1]),L_q([0,1]))$ having the weak maximizing property. More precisely, we prove that, for $1 2$.
